metadata.question: Does Kerala, India experience more rainfall between July and August 2018 compared to Sri Lanka?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use CHIRPS daily rainfall (UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY) for both Kerala (India) and Sri Lanka. - Date window: 1 Jul – 31 Aug 2018 (inclusive). - Geometry: create two separate polygons – one roughly enclosing Kerala state, one for the island of Sri Lanka (via hand-drawn rectangles). 2. Masking strategy: - CHIRPS is a precipitation-only product; no cloud mask required. - We will sum valid pixels inside each region; pixels equal to the “no-data” value (-9999) are already masked, but we will clip by the geometry so only the land area is considered. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Check collection size for the period; if zero → C1. - After clipping and summing, use ee.Reducer.count() to verify ≥1 valid pixel per region; if zero → C2. - Compare total rainfall (sum) between the two regions. - If Kerala sum > Sri Lanka sum → A, else B. - If any sum is None/NaN → C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time ker = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([74.8, 8.2, 77.5, 12.9]) # Kerala lka = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([79.5, 5.8, 81.9, 9.9]) # Sri Lanka period = ('2018-07-01', '2018-08-31') # 2. Data Acquisition col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY').filterDate(*period) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No CHIRPS images for Jul-Aug 2018.") print("C1") # 3. Processing sum_ker = col.sum().clip(ker) sum_lka = col.sum().clip(lka) # 4. Calculation scale = 5500 tot_ker = sum_ker.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=ker, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9).get('precipitation').getInfo() tot_lka = sum_lka.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=lka, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9).get('precipitation').getInfo() cnt_ker = sum_ker.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=ker, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9).get('precipitation').getInfo() cnt_lka = sum_lka.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=lka, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9).get('precipitation').getInfo() # 5. Validation & Answer print(f"Kerala: {tot_ker:.1f} mm, Pixels: {int(cnt_ker)}") print(f"SriLanka: {tot_lka:.1f} mm, Pixels: {int(cnt_lka)}") if None in (tot_ker, tot_lka): print("C3") elif cnt_ker == 0 or cnt_lka == 0: print("C2") else: print("A" if tot_ker > tot_lka else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
ker = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([74.8, 8.2, 77.5, 12.9])  # Kerala
lka = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([79.5, 5.8, 81.9, 9.9])   # Sri Lanka
period = ('2018-07-01', '2018-08-31')

# 2. Data Acquisition
col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY').filterDate(*period)
if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No CHIRPS images for Jul-Aug 2018.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

# 3. Processing
sum_ker = col.sum().clip(ker)
sum_lka = col.sum().clip(lka)

# 4. Calculation
scale = 5500
tot_ker = sum_ker.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
                                geometry=ker, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9).get('precipitation').getInfo()
tot_lka = sum_lka.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
                               geometry=lka, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9).get('precipitation').getInfo()
cnt_ker = sum_ker.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                               geometry=ker, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9).get('precipitation').getInfo()
cnt_lka = sum_lka.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                               geometry=lka, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9).get('precipitation').getInfo()

# 5. Validation & Answer
print(f"Kerala: {tot_ker:.1f} mm, Pixels: {int(cnt_ker)}")
print(f"SriLanka: {tot_lka:.1f} mm, Pixels: {int(cnt_lka)}")

if None in (tot_ker, tot_lka):
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif cnt_ker == 0 or cnt_lka == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>A</answer>" if tot_ker > tot_lka else "<answer>B</answer>")
